delta_classifications.explanation: W2 adds five product projection tables to the producer coverage inventory.
The five W2 projection tables are downstream-builder-required tables and now have a producer.
Operator validation reports the full 16-slice queue including four hard-gated slices; 12/12 executable local slices passed, but hard gates are not counted as complete.
Four generator fields plus the pinned demo-as-of date field were added so planted findings can be deterministic and time-stable.
Renewal notice date is now a first-class contract-register field so renewal posture can be preserved through adapters and projections instead of inferred at render time.
Home projection now carries four application-register passthrough fields already consumed by the Home read path: cloud readiness, authentication method, annual cost basis, and end-of-support date.
Demo findings add one net vendor and two net data-platform objects.
Contract finding planting introduces one additional governed supplier in the dense commercial estate.
Data and BI finding planting creates two additional distinct platform/function/workload combinations.
The unresolved-hosting defect was fixed by preserving platform identity. Remaining net increase comes from planted data-platform and data-flow relationships.
PR 6783 briefly reduced hosted_on to 1640 by overwriting a platform primary key. The planted Netezza finding now preserves the numeric platform_id, restoring one HOSTED_ON edge per deployment.
Revenue-cycle data-flow findings add three additional resolvable integration edges.
The Netezza platform finding introduces one platform-type-specific metric definition.
Unknown allocation rows in the finance extract now create invoice-line review events instead of disappearing. This preserves unknown-is-not-zero for attribution gaps.
Renewal notice dates create additional contract-subject review events for notice posture where the refreshed contract register now supplies the field explicitly.
F2 and commercial-protection findings add contract-subject review events for benchmarking, notice-window, and minimum-commitment gates.
The explicit renewal notice field adds contract-subject review events for contracts whose notice posture is now carried through the source-room register.
Invoice-line review subjects now include both estimated and unknown allocation_basis rows. Unknown allocation is a reviewable gap, not a reason to drop the subject.
The added governed supplier appears in Source vendor 360.
Additional review gates generate additional Source event-workspace rows.
W2 adds five product projection manifests for Tower value/evidence/AI and Intelligence pattern/question surfaces.

W2 adds one Tower value-chain projection row per contract with FK-backed claim-to-measure traceability, and the Tower period-trajectory slice adds 480 source-recorded finance-period rows that feed the trajectory chart without contributing to Tower aggregate totals.
Tower period-trajectory rows add one projection entry for each finance-period source row.

Home projection now emits one active-intake record row each for metrics/outcomes, risks/controls, programs/initiatives, org ownership, and AI use cases so those page keys can browse governed source rows without renaming source payloads.
Each Tower period-trajectory row links to the corresponding governed finance actual measure.
Each Tower period-trajectory row carries a metric reference to the existing actual spend metric definition.
The refreshed renewal notice field adds metric references for the additional contract review events generated from explicit notice posture.
Each Tower period-trajectory row resolves to the application, platform, or business-function object from the finance extract.
Each Tower period-trajectory row keeps a source-record reference to the finance extract row that supplied the period evidence.
W2 adds gated evidence rows for contracts and risk/control exceptions, each carrying gate reason and next evidence action.
W2 adds one Tower AI portfolio projection row per AI usage/model source-room row.
W2 adds Intelligence pattern-evidence rows for commercial leverage gaps and vendor risk clusters.
W2 adds deterministic question-context projection rows tied to context packs and source citations.

Home projection now emits one active-intake record row each for the five added Home page keys; the rows preserve intake column names and carry source-file references rather than pretending to be dense source-record FK rows.

purpose: Single expected-count contract for the dense local ECL proof. Count changes from planted demo findings are classified here before CI expectations move.
rules: A planted-data change may raise an expected count when the additional rows are traced to a named finding or producer.
A count decrease requires a written explanation and release record reference before the expected value may be updated.
Identity fields are not finding payloads. Demo findings must be planted through attributes or additional rows, not by replacing primary keys used by downstream relationships.
